scene: The glowing badge unlocks three transit gates lined along the museum's terrace.
picture: A flat side view along the museum's open terrace platform. At far left floats an open bubble lift capsule. Left of centre stands the Pacific Islander girl, wearing a glowing museum badge on her sky-blue windbreaker, sketchbook underarm. Centre sits an idling paint-splattered tram. Far right sways a red-and-white rooftop gondola cabin.
shown: a floating spherical bubble lift waiting open at the far left gate
a paint-splattered tram idling on glowing rails in the centre gate
a striped rooftop gondola swaying gently at the far right gate
